senses.gloss:
अभि अभि, ind. (a prefix to verbs and
nouns, expressing) to, towards, into, over, upon.
.(As a prefix to verbs of motion) it expresses the
notion of moving or going towards, approaching, &c.
.(As a prefix to nouns not derived from verbs) it ex-
presses superiority, intensity, &c.; e. g. अभि-ताम्र,
अभि-नव, q. v.
. (As a separable adverb or preposition) it expresses
(with acc.) to, towards, in the direction of, against;
in, into, to; for, for the sake of; on account of; on,
upon, with regard to; by, before, in front of; over.
It may even express one after the other, severally;
e. g. वृक्षम् वृक्षम् अभि, tree after tree [cf.
Gr. ἀμφί Lat. ob; Zend aibi; Goth. bi; Old
High Germ. bī].
अभी 1. अ-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, without fear, fearless.

अभी 2. अभी (अभि-इ), cl. 2. P. अभ्य्-एति,
-तुम्, to come near, approach; to go up to or
towards (with acc.); to go along, go after; to go into,
enter; to join; to go over to; to reach; to come
to, to fall to one's share (with acc.); to get; to fall
into: Ved. Intens. or Pass. -ईयते, to ask, request;
सकाशम् or समीपम् अभी, to go near.
1. अभीति, इस्, f., Ved. approach, assault. See next col.

अभिक, अस्, आ, अम्, lustful, libidinous; (अस्), m. a
lover, a husband. Some regard this as derived from
अभि-कम् [cf. अनिक].

अभीक 1. अभीक, अस्, आ, अम् (= अभिक, q. v.,
fr. अभि), longing after; lustful, libidinous; anxious,
desirous; (अस्), m. a lover, a husband, a master.

अभीक 2. अभीक, अम्, n. (fr. अभि-अच्; cf.
अनूक, अपाक, प्रतीक), Ved. meeting together, close-
ness, nearness; collision, combat, opposition; अभीके,
ind. in the neighbourhood, at the same place or time,
at the right time, just in time; in a moment, instan-
taneously; (with abl.) from, out of; on account of,
with regard to; from (in connection with verbs ex-
pressing defending from, &c.).

अभीक 3. अ-भीक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. भी), fear-
less; (अस्), m. a poet; a master.

आभीक आभीक, अम्, n., N. of a Sāma
melody.
अभि-तराम्, अभि-तस्. See s. v.

अभितराम् अभि-तराम्, ind. (compar. fr.
अभि), nearer to.

अभिकम् अभि-कम्, perf. -चकमे, -कमितुम्,
to desire, love.
अभि-कामिक, अस्, आ, अम्, voluntary.

अभिकम्प् अभि-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्पते,
-पितुम्, to tremble vehemently, to shake: Caus.
-कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to stir, allure.

अभिकाङ्क्ष् अभि-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. -काङ्क्षति,
-षितुम्, to ask, request, long for, desire; to strive.
अभि-काङ्क्षा, f. longing, wish, desire.

अभि-काङ्क्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, longed for, wished,
desired.

अभि-काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, longing for, wishing,
desiring.

अभिकाल अभि-काल, अस्, m., N. of a town;
see Rāmāyaṇa II. 68.

अभिकाश् अभि-काश्, Intens., Ved. -चाकशीति,
-चाकश्यते, to illuminate, irradiate; to look on, to
perceive.

अभिकुत्स् अभि-कुत्स्, cl. 10. P. A. -कुत्स्यति,
-ते, -यितुम्, to revile, to inveigh against.

अभिकुष् अभि-कुष्, cl. 9. P. -कुष्णाति,
-कोषितुम्, to pull, to tear.

अभिकूज् अभि-कूज्, cl. 1. P. -कूजति, -जितुम्,
to twitter, warble, coo.

अभिकृ अभि-कृ cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्,
to do with reference to or in behalf of; to procure,
effect; to render, make: Desid. -चिकीर्षति, to wish
to do; to long for.

अभिकॄ अभि-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम्
or -रीतुम्, to pour over, throw over, cover; to fill.
अभि-करण, अम्, n. effecting; incantation.

अभि-कृति, इस्, f., N. of a metre, containing one
hundred syllables.

अभि-कृत्वन्, वा, वरि, m. f., Ved. magical; a
magician, a spirit (producing diseases?).

अभिकृष् अभि-कृष्, cl. 1. 6. P. A. -कर्षति,
-ते, -कृषति, -ते, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to
overpower, to pull-down.

अभिकॢप् अभि-कॢप्, cl. 1. A. -कल्पते,
-पितुम् or -प्तुम्, to be adequate to, to answer; to
have the same meaning: Caus. -कल्पयति, -यितुम्,
to put in order.
अभि-कॢप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared, produced.

अभिक्नूय् अभि-क्नूय्, cl. 1. A. -क्नूयते,
-यितुम्, to bemoisten, bedew.

अभिक्रतु अभि-क्रतु, उस्, m., Ved. insolent,
haughty (as an enemy).

अभिक्रन्द् अभि-क्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. -क्रदति,
-दितुम्, to shout at, roar at, to neigh or whinny at.
अभि-क्रन्द, अस्, m. a shout.

अभिक्रम् अभि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A., cl. 4. P.
-क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to
step or go near to, approach; to fly at, attack; to
step upon; to undertake, begin: Caus. -क्रमयति,
-यितुम्, to bring near.

अभि-क्रम, अस्, m. assault, attack; ascending,
mounting; undertaking, attempt, beginning.
—अभि-
क्रम-नाश, अस्, m. unsuccessful effort.

अभि-क्रमण, अम्, n. or अभि-क्रान्ति, इस्, f.
stepping near, approaching.

अभि-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, approached; attacked,
begun.

अभि-क्रान्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has undertaken;
conversant with (with loc.).
अभि-क्रामम्, ind. having stepped near.

अभिक्री अभि-क्री, cl. 9. P. A. -क्रीणाति, -णीते,
-क्रेतुम्, to buy for a certain purpose.

अभिक्रुध् अभि-क्रुध्, cl. 4. P. -क्रुध्यति,
-क्रोद्धुम्, to be angry with (with acc.).

अभिक्रुश् अभि-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोसति,
-क्रोष्टुम्, to cry out at, call out to; to call to any
one in a scolding manner; to lament with tears, to
bemoan.

अभि-क्रोशक, अस्, m. a reviler, one who calls
out; a herald (?).

अभिक्षत्तृ अभि-क्षत्तृ, ता, m., Ved. mur-
derer, destroyer.
अभि-क्षत्तृ; add — one who carves food, a host.

अभिक्षदा अभि-क्षदा, f., Ved. (according
to native interpretation) destroying, a destroyer. It
is better, perhaps, to divide thus, अ-भिक्ष-दा, आस्,
m. giving without having been asked.

अभिक्षम् अभि-क्षम्, cl. 1. A. -क्षमते,
-क्षन्तुम्, to be gracious, propitious, to allow, to
pardon.

अभिक्षर् अभि-क्षर्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्षरति,
-ते, -रितुम्, Ved. -रध्यै, to flow near or round,
to pour on.

अभिक्षिप् अभि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. -क्षिपति,
-क्षेप्तुम्, to fling at (as the lash of a whip at a
horse), to insult; to excel.
अभि-क्षिपत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, surpassing.

अभिखन् अभि-खन्, cl. 1. P. A. -खनति,
-ते, -नितुम्, to dig up, to turn up (the soil).

अभिख्या 1. अभि-ख्या, cl. 2. P., Ved. -ख्याति,
-तुम्, to see, view, perceive; to cast a kind or gracious
look upon any one, to be gracious: in later Sanskrit
the rt. ख्या conveys the idea of telling, making
known: Caus. -ख्यापयति, -यितुम्, to make known.
.2. अभि-ख्या, f. look, view; splendor; beauty; fame,
glory; notoriety; telling; calling, addressing; a name,
appellation.

अभि-ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, become known, mani-
fested.

अभि-ख्यातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. looking, super-
vising, superintending.
अभि-ख्यान, अम्, n. fame, glory.

अभिगम् अभि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-
तुम्, to go near to, approach (with acc.); to follow;
to meet with, to find; to cohabit, have intercourse
with a woman; to undertake; to get, gain, obtain:
Caus. -गमयति, -यितुम्, to cause to obtain, to
cause to apprehend, to explain.
अभि-गच्छत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, approaching, &c.
अभि-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, &c.

अभि-गन्तृ, ता, m. one who approaches, one who
has intercourse with a woman; one who understands.

अभि-गम, अस्, m. or अभि-गमन, अम्, n. ap-
proaching, visiting; sexual intercourse.

1. अभि-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be visited; accessi-
ble; inviting.
2. अभि-गम्य, ind. having approached.
अभि-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having intercourse with.
अभिगर अभि-गर. See अभि-गॄ below.
अभि-गर, अस्, m., Ved. song of praise; praising.

अभिगर्ज् अभि-गर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -गर्जति, -जितुम्,
to roar at, to bawl at; to raise savage or ferocious cries.
अभि-गर्जन, अम्, n. ferocious roaring, uproar.
अभि-गर्जित, अम्, n. a savage cry, uproar.

अभिगा अभि-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्,
to go near to, to approach, arrive at; to get, gain.

अभिगाह् अभि-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -हितुम्,
गाढुम्, to penetrate into.

अभिगुप् अभि-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपायति, -गोप्-
तुम्, or Caus. -गोपयति, -यितुम्, to guard, protect.

अभि-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, guarded, protected, hid-
den, concealed.
अभि-गुप्ति, इस्, f. guarding, protecting.
अभि-गोप्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, guarding, protecting.

अभिगुर् अभि-गुर्, cl. 6. P. A. -गुरति, -ते,
-रितुम्, to assent, agree, approve of.

अभि-गूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, approved of, destined for
(an offering, &c.), accompanied with applause (?).

अभि-गूर्ति, इस्, f., Ved. making resolution or effort,
song of praise, hymn (?).

अभिगॄ अभि-गॄ, cl. 9. P. A., Ved. -गृणाति,
-णीते, -गरितुम् or -रीतुम्, to call to or address with
approbation; to join in; to welcome, praise; to ap-
prove of, to accept propitiously, to allow.

अभिग्रस् अभि-ग्रस्, cl. 1. A. -ग्रसते, -सि-
तुम्, to overcome.
अभि-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, subdued, overcome.

अभिग्रह् अभि-ग्रह्, Ved. -ग्रभ्, cl. 9. P. A.
-गृह्णाति, -णीते, Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्,
to seize, catch, take hold of; accept; to set (as a blos-
som); to lay together, to fold; to receive (as a guest):
Caus. -ग्राहयति, -यितुम्, to catch, surprise in the
act; to let one's self be caught; e. g. रूपाभि-
ग्राहित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken in the very act.

अभि-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, seized, taken hold of.
—अभिगृहीत-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the hands
joined.

अभि-ग्रध, अस्, m. attack, onset; defiance, chal-
lenge; seizing, robbing, plundering; authority, weight.

अभि-ग्रहण, अम्, n. robbing, seizing anything
in presence of the owner.

अभिघर्षण अभि-घर्षण, अम्, n. (rt.
घृष्), rubbing, friction; possession by an evil spirit.

अभिघात अभि-घात, अस्, m. (rt. हन्),
striking, attack, infliction of injury, damage; striking
back, driving away, warding off; abrupt or vehement
articulation of Vedic texts; (अम्), n. the combina-
tion of the fourth letter of any class with the first or
third letter; of the second with the first letter; and
of the third with the second letter of any class.
अभि-घात. See s. v.
अभीघात अभी-घात. See अभि-घात.

अभि-घातक, अस्, इका, अम्, keeping back, re-
moving.

अभि-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ striking, attacking, hurting;
inflicting injury; (ई), m. an assailant, enemy.

अभिघृ अभि-घृ, Caus. P. -घारयति, -यि-
तुम्, to cause to trickle down; to sprinkle with.

अभि-घार, अस्, m. ghee or clarified butter, drop-
ping it on the oblation.

अभि-घारण, अम्, n. the act of sprinkling ghee,
besprinkling.

अभि-घारित, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled (as ghee),
dropped upon.
अभि-घार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sprinkled.

अभिघ्रा अभि-घ्रा, cl. 1. P. -जिघ्रति, -घ्रा-
तुम्, to snuffle, smell at; to bring the nose close to
another's forehead in caressing, or as a taken of af-
fection.

अभिचक्ष् अभि-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे,
-ष्टुम्, to look at, view, perceive; to oversee; to
cast a kind or gracious look upon any one; to address,
to assail with harsh language; to call.

अभि-चक्षण, अम्, n., Ved. caution, means of
defence; magic remedy; (आ), f., Ved. viewing, indi-
cating (?).

अभि-चक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken of every-
where.

अभिचर् अभि-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -रितुम्,
Ved. -रितवे, -वै, -रसे, -रध्यै, to act wrongly
towards any one; to be faithless (as a wife); to
charm, enchant, exorcise; to possess.
अभि-चर, अस्, m. a servant.

अभि-चार, अस्, m. exorcising, incantation, employ-
ment of spells for a malevolent purpose; magic, one
of the Upapātakas or minor crimes.
—अभिचार-
कल्प, अस्, m. title of a work on incantations, belong-
ing to the Atharva-veda.
—अभिचार-ज्वर, अस्, m.
a fever caused by magical spells.
—अभिचार-मन्त्र,
अस्, m. a formula or prayer for working a charm, an
incantation.
—अभिचार-यज्ञ or अभिचार-होम,
अस्, m. a sacrifice for the same purpose.
अभि-चरण, अम्, n. enchanting, exorcising.

अभि-चरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for enchanting or
exorcising.

अभि-चारणीय or अभि-चार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
enchanted.

अभि-चरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, employing spells or en-
chantments.

अभि-चरितु, उस्, f., Ved. enchanting.
—अभि-चरि-
तोस्, to enchant.

अभि-चारक, अस्, इका, अम्, or अभि-चारिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, enchanting, exorcising, conjuring; a conjurer, a
magician.
अभि-चारित, अस्, आ, अम्, enchanted, charmed.

अभिचाकशीति अभि-चाकशीति. See अभि-
काश्, p. 61, col. 1.

अभिचिन्त् अभि-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति,
-यितुम्, to reflect on.

अभिचिह्नय अभि-चिह्नय, nom. P. -चिह्न-
यति, -यितुम्, to mark, characterize.
अभिचैद्य अभि-चैद्य, अस्, m., N. of Śiśupāla.

अभिच्छद् अभि-च्छद् (-छद्), cl. 10. P.
-च्छादयति or च्छदयति, -यितुम्, to cover over.

अभिच्छायम् अभि-च्छायम्, ind., Ved. in
darkness.

अभिजग्मिवस् अभि-जग्मिवस्, वान्, मुषी,
वत्, perf. part. of अभि-गम्, q. v., p. 61, col. 2.

अभिजन् अभि-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनि-
तुम्, to be born for or to; to claim as one's birth-
right; to be born or produced; to be reproduced or
born again; to become.
अभि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced all round.

अभि-जन, अस्, m. family, race; descendants; an-
cestors; noble descent; the head or ornament of a
family; native country; fame, notoriety.
—अभिजन-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, of noble descent.

आभिजन आभिजन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-जन,
rt. जन्), relating to descent; (अम्), n. loftiness of
birth.

अभि-जनितु, उस्, f., Ved. the being born or pro-
duced.
—अभि-जनितोस्, to produce.
अभि-जाति, इस्, f. descent, birth.

अभिजप् अभि-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -पितुम्,
to mutter over or whiper to.

अभिजभ् अभि-जभ्, Intens., Ved. -जञ्जभ्-
यते, to try to swallow, open the mouth to do so.

अभिजल्प् अभि-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -पि-
तुम्, to address, to accompany with remarks; to ad-
vocate, to settle by conversation.

अभिजि अभि-जि, cl. 1. P. -जयति, -जेतुम्, to
conquer completely, to acquire by conquest: Desid.
-जिगीषति, to try to win, to attack.
अभि-जय, अस् m. conquest, complete victory.

अभि-जित्, त्, त्, त्, victorious; born under the con-
stellation Abhijit; (त्), m., N. of Viṣṇu; of a Soma
sacrifice, part of the great sacrifice Gavām-ayana;
N. of a son of Punarvasu, or of his father; (त्), f.,
N. of a star (अ Lyræ); one of the Nakṣatras or
lunar mansions; (त्), n. the eighth Muhūrta of the
day; midday.
—अभिजिन्-मुहूर्त, अस्, m. the
eighth Muhūrta, or period comprising twenty-four

conquered.

P. A. -णुदति, -ते, -णोत्तुम्, to drive out, frighten
away, remove.

अभिनिर्दिश् अभि-निर्-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति,
-देष्टुम्, to point out, indicate, appoint, characterize.

अभिनिर्भर्त्स् अभि-निर्-भर्त्स्, cl. 10. A. or P.
-भर्त्सयते, -ति, -यितुम्, to scold, threaten.

अभिनिर्मित अभि-निर्मित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. मा),
made, created.

left, quitted (by the sun when it sets), i.e one asleep
at sunset.

to march out.

अभि-निर्याण, अम्, n. march of an assailant,
invasion.

complished.

wards; (अम्), ind. having turned towards.

-वेष्टुम्, to enter into possession of; to sit down in
or be settled in, to occupy: Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्,
to make one enter into or sit down, apply, &c.

tentness, study, affection, devotion; determination to
effect a purpose or attain an object; tenacity, adher-
ance; ignorant fear causing death (?).

अभि-निवेशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to enter into,
plunged into.

अभि-निवेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, intent upon, devoted to,
determined.

अभिनिशम् अभि-नि-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति,
-शमितुम्, or Caus. P. -शामयति, -यितुम्, to ob-
serve, perceive.

अभिनिश्चित अभि-निश्चित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. चि),
quite convinced of.

अभिनिष्कारिन् अभि-निष्-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ
(rt. कृ), Ved. intending anything evil against, in-
juring.

अभि-निष्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, directed against (as
an evil action).

1. P. A., cl. 4. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्राम्यति,
-क्रमितुम्, to go out or forth, to lead towards.

अभि-निष्क्रमण, अम्, n. going forth; (with
Buddhists) leaving the house in order to become an
anchorite.
अभि-निष्क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone out or forth.

अभिनिष्पत् अभि-निष्-पत् (-निस्-पत्), cl. 1. P.
-पतति, -तितुम्, to fly away, rush out; to spring
forth, shoot forth.
अभि-निष्पतन, अम्, n. issuing, sallying.

अभिनिष्पद् अभि-निष्-पद् (-निस्-पद्), cl. 4.
A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to come to; to enter into, be-
come (with acc.); to appear: Caus. -पादयति, -यि-
तुम्, to bring to help to.

अभि-निष्पत्ति, इस्, f. completion, end, termina-
tion; appearance (?).
अभि-निष्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, completed.

अभिनिह्नव अभि-निह्नव, अस्, m. (rt. ह्नु),
denial.

अभिनी 1. अभि-नी, cl. 1. P. -नयति, -नेतुम्,
to bring near, conduct towards, adduce, introduce,
quote; represent dramatically, act.

अभिनी 2. अभि-नी (अभि-नि-इ), cl. 2. P.
-न्येति, -तुम्, to go in to, to approach a woman.

friendship, civility, kindness.

अभि-नीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being brought near,
&c.

presented dramatically.
अभि-नेतृ, ता, त्री, m. f. an actor, an actress.

अभिनील अभि-नील, अस्, आ, अम्, very black,
very dark.

अभिनु 1. अभि-नु, cl. 2. 6. P. -नौति,
-नुवति, -नवितुम् or -नुवितुम्, to extol, praise.

अभिनु 2. अभि-नु, cl. 1. A., Ved. -नवते,
to turn one's self towards.

अभिनुद् अभि-नुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -नुदति, -ते,
-नोत्तुम्, to push, press: Caus. -नोदयति, -यितुम्,
to excite, to spur or urge on.

unbroken; unchanged, unaltered, not different; un-
divided, one; same, identical; (अस्), m. an integer,
a whole number (in arithmetic).

gers or whole numbers.

अभिन्यस् अभि-न्य्-अस् (-नि-अस्), cl. 4. P.
-अस्यति, -सितुम्, to depress.
अभि-न्यास, अस्, m. a kind of fever.

अभिन्युब्ज् अभि-न्य्-उब्ज् (-नि-उब्ज्), cl. 6. P.
-उब्जति, -जितुम्, to press down, to hold down.

अभिपच् अभि-पच्, cl. 1. P. A. -पचति, -ते,
-पक्तुम्, to boil up (as milk).

अभिपठित अभि-पठित, अस्, आ, अम्, denomi-
nated, named.

अभिपत् 1. अभि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -तितुम्,
to fly near, hasten near; to assail; to fall down, fall;
to fall into, come into; to overtake in flying: Caus.
-पातयति, -यितुम्, to throw on or down.

अभिपत् 2. अभि-पत्, cl. 4. A., Ved. -पत्यते,
to be master or lord over, to possess.

अभि-पतन, अम्, n. approaching, assailing, seiz-
ing; falling into.

अभिपद् अभि-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्-
तुम्, to draw near, approach; to come up (as an
auxiliary), assist; to honour; to seize, catch, over-
power, master; to take possession of; to accept; to
undertake, devote one's self to anything.
अभि-पत्ति, इस्, f. drawing near, approaching.

अभि-पन्नम् अस्, आ, अम्, gone near; approached,
obtained; flown, fugitive; seeking refuge; subdued;
unfortunate, calamitous; guilty; removed to a dis-
tance, dead.

अभिपद्म अभि-पद्म, अस्, आ, अम्, exceedingly
handsome (lit. superior to the lotus).

अभिपरिग्लान अभि-परिग्लान, अस्, आ, अम् (rt.
ग्लै), tired, exhausted.

-प्लोतुम्, to stream or flow so as to inundate, to
overflow.

अभि-परिप्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, overwhelmed, over-
flowed, filled with; shaken; attacked, affected by.

अभिपरिष्वञ्ज् अभि-परि-ष्वञ्ज् (-स्वञ्ज्), cl.
1. A. -ष्वजते, -ष्वङ्क्तुम्, to embrace.

अभिपरीत अभि-परीत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. इ with
अभि-परि), surrounded, overpowered by, over-
whelmed with.

अभिपरे अभि-परे (-परा-इ), cl. 2. P.
-परैति, -तुम्, to go away towards.

अभिपर्ये अभि-पर्य्-ए (-परि-आ-इ), cl. 2. P.
-पर्यैति, -तुम्, to go about; glide away, pass away.

अभिपा 1. अभि-पा, cl. 1. P. -पिबति, -पातुम्,
to drink of.

अभिपा 2. अभि-पा, cl. 2. P. -पाति, -तुम्, to
protect: Caus. P. -पालयति, -यितुम्, to protect, to
assist.

अभि-पीत, अस्, आ, अम्, watered (as cattle), filled
with drink.

अपित्व, fr. obs. rt. अप्; see अप-पित्व), Ved. ap-
proaching, visiting, putting up (for the night at an
inn), close or departure of day, evening; dawn; sacri-
fice.

अभिपीड् अभि-पीड्, cl. 10. P. -पीडयति, -यि-
तुम्, to oppress, torment, afflict.
अभि-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, harassed.

अभिपुथ् अभि-पुथ्, Caus. P. -पोथयति,
-यितुम्, to throw with violence; dash against.

अभिपुष्प अभि-पुष्प, अस्, आ, अम्, covered
with flowers; (अम्), n. an excellent flower.

अभिपूज् अभि-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूजयति, -यि-
तुम्, to honour, approve, assent to.
अभि-पूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, honoured; approved.

अभि-पूज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being greatly rever-
enced.

अभिपूर्वम् अभि-पूर्वम्, ind. one after the
other.

अभिपृण् अभि-पृण्, cl. 6. P. -पृणति, -पर्-
तुम्, to be filled; to be glad.

-परितुम् or -रीतुम्, to fill: Pass. -पूर्यते, to fill
one's self, become full: Caus. -पूरयति, -यितुम्, to
fill, make full; to load with, cover with; to present
with; to master completely.
अभि-पूरण, अम्, n. filling.

अभि-पूरण, अस्, आ, अम्, full of (with inst. or
gen.); filled; fraught; laden.

अभिप्यै अभि-प्यै, cl. 1. A., Ved. -प्यायते,
-प्यातुम् or -प्यायितुम्, to swell, to abound with.

अभिप्रकम्प् अभि-प्र-कम्प्, Caus. P. -कम्प्-
अयति, -यितुम्, to stir, allure.

अभिप्रकाश् अभि-प्र-काश्, cl. 1. 4. A. -काशते,
काश्यते, -शितुम्, to become visible, to show one's
self.

अभिप्रक्रम् अभि-प्र-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A., cl. 4.
A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to
go up to, approach.

अभिप्रक्षर् अभि-प्र-क्षर्, cl. 1. P. A.
-क्षरति, -ते, -रितुम्, Ved. -रध्यै, to stream
towards a place.

अभिप्रक्षल् अभि-प्र-क्षल्, cl. 10. P. -क्षाल्-
अयति, -यितुम्, to clean thoroughly, polish up.

अभिप्रगाह् अभि-प्र-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते,

हितुम्, -गाढुम्, to penetrate, dip, or plunge into,
join: Caus. -गाहयति, -यितुम्, to immerse, dip.

अभिप्रगै अभि-प्र-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति,
गातुम्, to begin to praise.

अभिप्रचक्ष् अभि-प्र-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A., Ved.
-चष्टे, -ष्टुम्, to throw light upon; to see (?).

अभिप्रचुद् अभि-प्र-चुद्, Caus. P. -चोदयति,
-यितुम्, to impel, induce, persuade.

-च्योतुम्, to move towards, arrive at.

अभिप्रछ् अभि-प्रछ्, cl. 6. P. -पृच्छति,
-प्रष्टुम्, to ask or inquire after.

अभिप्रजन् अभि-प्र-जन्, Caus. P. -जनयति,
-यितुम्, to beget for (a purpose).

अभिप्रज्वल् अभि-प्र-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति,
-लितुम्, to flare up.

अभिप्रणक्ष् अभि-प्र-णक्ष् (-नक्ष्), cl. 1.
P., Ved. -णक्षति, -षितुम्, to overpower.

अभिप्रणद् अभि-प्र-णद् (-नद्), cl. 1. P.A.
-णदति, -ते, -दितुम्, to shout at, to scream; to
begin to roar or sound.

अभिप्रणम् अभि-प्र-णम् (-नम्), cl. 1. P. A.
-णमति, -ते, -णन्तुम्, to bow before (with dat. or
acc.).
अभि-प्रणत, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, bowing before.

अभिप्रणी अभि-प्र-णी (-नी), cl. 1. P. -णयति,
-णेतुम्, to lead forth; bring towards.

अभि-प्रणय, अस्, m. propitiation; affection,
favour.

अभि-प्रणीत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought, attracted;
consecrated; invoked, propitiated.

अभिप्रणु अभि-प्र-णु (-नु), cl. 2. 6. P., Ved.
-णौति, -णुवति, -णवितुम् or -णुवितुम्, to praise
highly, extol.

अभिप्रतप्त अभि-प्रतप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. तप्),
intensely heated; dried up; exhausted with pain or
fever.

अभिप्रतारिन् अभि-प्रतारिम्, ई, m., N. of a
descendant of Kakṣa-sena.

अभिप्रतिपद् अभि-प्रति-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्-
यते, -पत्तुम्, to begin with or at.

अभिप्रतिपिष् अभि-प्रति-पिष्, cl. 7. P., Ved.
-पिनष्टि, -पेष्टुम्, to dash or crush out.

अभिप्रत्यवे अभि-प्रत्य्-अवे (-प्रति-अव-इ), cl.

अभिप्रत्ये अभि-प्रत्य्-ए (-प्रति-आ-इ), cl. 2. P.
-प्रत्यैति, -तुम्, to come back towards, return.

अभिप्रथन अभि-प्रथन, अम्, n. (rt. प्रथ्),
spreading or extending over.

अभिप्रदक्षिणम् अभि-प्र-दक्षिणम्, ind. to

the object on the right.)

अभिप्रदिश् अभि-प्र-दिश्, Caus. P. -देशयति,
-यितुम्, to urge on.

-पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्, to look at, look out for.

अभिप्रदॄ अभि-प्र-दॄ, Pass. -दीर्यते, to be
scattered or divided asunder.

-ते, -पक्तुम्, to cause to cook, ripen; to develope.

अभिप्रपद् अभि-प्र-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते,

-पत्तुम्, to come towards, enter, hasten towards,
resort to (with acc.); to undertake.
अभि-प्रपन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, attained.

अभिप्रपीड् अभि-प्र-पीड्, Caus. P. -पीडयति,
-यितुम्, to cause pain, torture.

अभिप्रपॄ अभि-प्र-पॄ, Pass. -पूर्यते, to be
filled, fill one's self completely.

अभिप्रभङ्गिन् अभि-प्र-भङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ (rt.
भञ्ज्), Ved. breaking completely.

अभिप्रमन्द् अभि-प्र-मन्द्, cl. 1. P., Ved.
-मन्दति, -दितुम्, to gladden.

अभिप्रमुर् अभि-प्र-मुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, Ved.

rounded; (if fr. rt. मृ) destroying (?).

-मृशति, -मर्ष्टुम्, -म्रष्टुम्, to offer, grant.

अभिप्रया अभि-प्र-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -तुम्,

proached.

अयति, -यितुम्, to propitiate, make happy, console.

अभिरुच् अभि-रुच्, Caus. P. -रोचयति, -यि-
तुम्, to long for, desire, be inclined to, have a taste
for, to like.
अभीरुच् अभी-रुच्. See अभि-रुचि.

अभि-रुचि, इस्, f. desire, delight, taste, relish, plea-
sure; desire of fame, ambition; splendor.

अभि-रुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, delighted, de-
lighting in.

अभि-रुचिर, अस्, आ, अम्, very pleasant, desirable
or pretty.

अभिरुत अभि-रुत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. रु),
sounded; cooed, vocal (as the voices of birds, &c.).

अभिरुह् अभि-रुह्, cl. 1. P. -रोहति, -रोढुम्,
to ascend, mount.
अभि-रुह्य, ind. having ascended.

अभि-रूपक, अस्, आ, अम्, corresponding; pleasing,
handsome; learned.

अभिरोरुद अभि-रोरुद, अस्, आ, अम् (Intens.
of rt. रुद्), Ved. causing tears (of earnest desire).

अभिलक्षित अभि-लक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, marked
with signs, bearing marks.

अभि-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be marked or noted;
(अम्), ind. towards a mark or aim.

अभिलङ्घ् अभि-लङ्घ्, cl. 10. P. -लङ्घ-
यति, -यितुम्, to jump across or over.
अभि-लङ्घन, अम्, n. jumping across or over.

अभिलभ् अभि-लभ्, Desid. A. or poet. P.
-लिप्सते, -ति, to desire to obtain, covet.
अभि-लम्भन, अम्, n. obtaining transition (?).
अभि-लिप्सा, f. desire of obtaining.

अभिलष् अभि-लष्, cl. 1. 4. P. -लषति,
-लष्यति, -षितुम्, to desire or wish for, covet, crave.
अभि-लषण, अम्, n. craving after, desiring.
अभि-लषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, desirable, to be coveted.

अभि-लषित, अस्, आ, अम्, desired, wished; (अम्),
n. desire, wish, will, pleasure.

अभि-लाष or (less correctly) अभि-लास, अस्, m.
desire, wish, covetousness, affection, love.

अभि-लाषक, अस्, इका, अम्, or अभि-लाषिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, or अभि-लाषुक, अस्, आ, अम्, or (less cor-
rectly) अभि-लासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wishing, desiring, de-
sirous, covetous, greedy.

अभिलाप अभि-लाप, अस्, m. (rt. लप्), ex-
pression, word, speech; declaration of the object of
a vow or religious obligation.

अभिलाव अभि-लाव, अस्, m. (rt. लू), cutting,
reaping, mowing.

अभिलिखित अभि-लिखित, अस्, आ, अम्, in-
scribed, inserted in writing.
अभि-लेखन, अम्, n. writing upon, inscribing.

अभिलीन अभि-लीन, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ली), ad-
hering to, shrouding; embraced; embracing.

अभिलुप्त अभि-लुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, disturbed,
injured.

अभिलुलित अभि-लुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, playful,
unsteady; agitated, disturbed, injured.

अभिलूता अभि-लूता, f. an insect, a kind of
spider.

अभिवच् अभि-वच्, cl. 2. P. -वक्ति, -क्तुम्,
to speak to, address; to tell.

अभिवञ्चित अभि-वञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. वञ्च्),
cheated, deceived.

अभिवत् अभि-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing
the word अभि.

अभिवद् अभि-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते,
-दितुम्, to address or salute with reverence: Caus.
-वादयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to address or salute rever-
entlty; to salute through another person; to play on
an instrument.
अभि-वदन, अम्, n. addressing, salutation.

अभि-वाद, अस्, m. reverential salutation; (for अति-
वाद), opprobrious or unfriendly speech, abuse.

अभि-वादक, अस्, इका, अम्, a saluter, saluting,
offering salutation; civil, polite.

अभि-वादनम्, अम्, n. respectful salutation, including
sometimes the name or title of the person so addressed
and followed by the mention of the person's own
name; salutation of a superior or elder by a junior
or inferior, and especially of a teacher by his disciple;
(in general it is merely lifting the joined hands to
the forehead and saying अहम् अभिवादये, I salute).
—अभिवादन-शील, अस्, आ, अम्, one who habitu-
ally salutes, respectful.
अभि-वादयितृ, ता, त्री, m. f. a respectful saluter.
अभि-वादित, अस्, आ, अम्, saluted respectfully.
अभि-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, telling, enunciating, describing.

अभि-वाद्य or अभि-वादनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
respectfully saluted.

अभिवन्द् अभि-वन्द्, cl. 1. A. -वन्दते,
-दितुम्, to salute respectfully.
अभि-वन्दन, अम्, n. saluting respectfully.

अभिवप् अभि-वप्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -वपति,
-प्तुम्, to join, come together.

अभिवयस् अभि-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. very
youthful, fresh; possessed of food.
अभिवर्त अभि-वर्त, &c. See अभि-वृत्.

अभीवर्त अभी-वर्त, अस्, m. (fr. अभि-वृत्,
q. v.), Ved. existing everywhere, going towards, ap-
proaching, attacking successfully; successful assault,
victory; a hymn recited in attacking the enemy.

अभिवर्षण अभि-वर्षण, &c. See अभि-
वृष्.

अभि-वर्षण, अम्, n. watering, bedewing; rain-
ing upon.

अभिवस् अभि-वस्, Caus. P. -वासयति, -यि-
तुम्, to clothe, cover.
अभि-वास, अस्, m. or अभि-वासन, अम्, n. covering.
अभि-वास, ind. over the cloth or covering.

अभिवह अभि-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, conveying
near or towards, driving near.
अभि-वहन, अम्, n. conveying towards or near.

अभि-वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be carried near; (अम्),
n. conveyance, transmission; presentation, offering.

अभिवा अभि-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -तुम्, to
blow upon or towards.
अभि-वातम्, ind. towards the wind, windwards.

अभिवाञ्छ् अभि-वाञ्छ्, cl. 1. P. -वाञ्छति,
-छितुम्, to long for, desire.

अभिवान्या अभि-वान्या or अभिवान्य-वत्सा,
f. (fr. अभिवा, obtained?, and अन्य), Ved. a cow
who suckles an adopted calf.

अभिविख्या अभि-वि-ख्या, cl. 2. P. -ख्याति,
-तुम्, Ved. to look at, view. In later Sanskrit, to
tell, to call.

अभि-विख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, universally known, re-
nowned, known as, called.

अभिविचक्ष् अभि-वि-चक्ष्, cl. 2. A. -चष्टे,
Ved. to look towards. In later Sanskrit the idea of
speaking is usually inherent in चक्ष्.

अभिविचर् अभि-वि-चर्, cl. 1. A. -चरते,
-रितुम्, Ved. -तवे, -तवै, -रसे, -रध्यै, to ap-
proach; cl. 10. P. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to discuss.

अभिविजंह् अभि-वि-जंह् Ved., Intens. 3rd
sing. -जङ्गहे, to twitch convulsively.

अभिविज्ञा अभि-वि-ज्ञा, cl. 9. P. -जानाति, -ज्ञा-
तुम्, to be aware, to know, perceive.
अभि-विज्ञप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, notified, made known.

अभिविज्वल् अभि-वि-ज्वल्, cl. 1. P. -ज्वलति,
-लितुम्, to flame or blaze against or opposite to.

अभिवितन् अभि-वि-तन्, cl. 8. P. A., Ved.
-तनोति, -नुते, -नितुम्, to stretch (the string) over
or across (the bow); to stretch over, cover.

अभिविद् अभि-विद्, cl. 6. P. A. -विन्दति, -ते,
-वेदितुम्, to find, obtain; to seek.

अभिविदृश् अभि-वि-दृश्, cl. 1. P., Ved.
-पश्यति, -द्रष्टुम्, to look at, behold.

अभिविधि अभि-विधि, इस्, m. complete co-
incidence, complete comprehension or inclusion,

अभिविनद् अभि-वि-नद्, cl. 1. P. -नदति,
-दितुम्, to raise a loud noise.

अभिविनी अभि-वि-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति,
-ते, -नेतुम्, to inform, instruct.

अभि-विनीत, अस्, आ, अम्, well-behaved; well-disci-
plined; pious, pure, devout.

अभिविनुद् अभि-वि-नुद्, Caus. P. -नोदयति,
-यितुम्, to gladden, cause to rejoice.

अभिविभा अभि-वि-भा, cl. 2. P., Ved. -भाति,
-तुम्, to illuminate.

अभिविमान अभि-विमान, अस्, आ, अम्, of un-
limited dimensions.

अभिविया अभि-वि-या, cl. 2. P., Ved. -याति,
-तुम्, to approach, visit.

अभिविराज् अभि-वि-राज्, cl. 1. A. -राजते,
-जितुम्, to shine, be radiant.
अभिविशङ्किन् अभि-विशङ्किन्, ई, इनी, इ, afraid.

अभिविश्रुत अभि-विश्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, widely
celebrated.

अभिविश्वस् अभि-वि-श्वस्, Caus. P. -श्वास-
यति, -यितुम्, to render confident or secure.

अभिवी अभि-वी (-वि-इ), cl. 2. P. -व्येति, -तुम्,
to come together towards, meet together in.

अभिवीक्ष् अभि-वीक्ष् (-वि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A.
-वीक्षते, -क्षितुम्, to look at, view, perceive; to
aim at, to examine; to be affected towards.
अभि-वीक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, perceived.
अभि-वीक्ष्य, ind. having seen or observed.

अभिवीर अभि-वीर, अस्, m., Ved. surrounded
by men or heroes.

अभिवृत् अभि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -तितुम्,
to go towards, to face, to approach, come up, attack,
to turn up, arise.
अभी-वृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. abiding everywhere.

अभि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going towards, approaching,
attacking.

अभि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone towards; turning
towards.

अभिवृत अभि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. वृ),
chosen, selected.

अभीवृत अभी-वृत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. वृ),
covered, surrounded.

अभिवृध् अभि-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते,
-धितुम्, to increase, prosper.
अभि-वृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, increased, augmented.
अभि-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase, addition, success.

अभिवृष् अभि-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -षि-
तुम्, to rain upon, water, bedew, cover with a shower
(e. g. of blossoms); to shower down; to cause to rain.
अभि-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, bedewing; raining upon.
अभि-वृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, bedewed; rained upon.

अभिवेग अभि-वेग, अस्, m. (rt. विज्), con-
sideration, determination.

अभिव्यञ्ज् अभि-व्य्-अञ्ज् (-वि-अञ्ज्), cl. 7. P.
-अनक्ति, -अञ्जितुम् or अङ्क्तुम्, to manifest, reveal.

अभि-व्यक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, manifest, evident, distinct,
[]
plain; declared, revealed; (अम्), ind. manifestly,
plainly.

अभि-व्यक्ति, इस्, f. manifestation, distinction; de-
claration, revelation.

अभि-व्यङ्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be manifested or
made clear.
अभि-व्यज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being manifested.

अभि-व्यञ्जक, अस्, इका, अम्, revealing, mani-
festing; indicative, showing.

अभि-व्यञ्जन, अम्, n. making manifest, act of
revealing.

अभिव्यन् अभि-व्य्-अन् (-वि-अन्), cl. 2. P.
-अनिति, -नितुम्, to breathe through, to fill with
breath.

अभिव्यादा अभि-व्य्-आ-दा (-वि-आ-दा), cl. 3. P.
A. -ददाति, -दत्ते, -दातुम्, to open one's mouth
(for swallowing).

अभि-व्यादान, अम्, n. suppressed sound; repeti-
tion of the same sound.

अभिव्याधिन् अभि-व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ (rt.
व्यध्), striking at, hurting much, injuring greatly.

अभिव्याप् अभि-व्य्-आप् (-वि-आप्), cl. 5. P.
-आप्नोति, -आप्तुम्, to extend to, to comprehend, in-
clude, pervade, surround.

अभि-व्यापक, अस्, इका, अम्, or अभि-व्यापिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, including, comprehending.

अभि-व्याप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, included, comprehended,
co-extended, &c.

अभि-व्याप्ति, इस्, f. co-extending, universal perva-
sion, inclusion, comprehension.
1. अभि-व्याप्य, ind. up to a certain point inclusive.

2. अभि-व्याप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be included; (अम्),
n. validity of a rule (?).

अभिव्याहृ अभि-व्य्-आ-हृ (-वि-आ-हृ), Caus.
P. -हारयति, -यितुम्, to utter, pronounce, tell,
explain.

अभि-व्याहरण, अम्, n. or अभि-व्याहार, अस्,
m. pronunciation, utterance; an articulate significant
word or phrase.
अभि-व्याहारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, pronouncing, telling.

अभि-व्याहृत, अस्, आ, अम्, pronounced, spoken,
told.

अभिव्युक्ष् अभि-व्य्-उक्ष् (-वि-उक्ष्), cl. 1. P.
-उक्षति, -षितुम्, to sprinkle towards.

अभिव्लङ्ग अभि-व्लङ्ग, अस्, m. (rt. व्लङ्ग्),
Ved. assault, shaking off.

अभिशंस् अभि-शंस्, cl. 1. P. -शंसति, -सितुम्,
to accuse, blame, calumniate, abuse.

अभि-शंसक, अस्, इका, अम्, or अभि-शंसिन्, ई,
इनी, इ, accusing; insulting; abusive.
अभि-शंसन, अम्, n. accusation; insult.

1. अभि-शस्, अस्, f., Ved. accusation, imprecation,
solicitation (?). For 2. see next col.

अभिशस् 2. अभि-शस्, cl. 1. P. -शसति, -सि-
तुम्, to hurt, injure, attack. (See under अभि-शंस्.)
3. अभि-शस्, f., Ved. injuring (?). For 1. अभि-शस्,
see under अभि-शंस्, p. 67, col. 3.

1. अभि-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, falsely accused, calumni-
ated; defamed, infamous; sinful, wicked. See next col.
2. अभि-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, injured, hurt, attacked.

अभिशस्त, अपभिशस्ति। See अभि-शंस् and
अभि-शस्.

अभि-शतक, अस्, इका, अम्, falsely accused, cursed;
caused by imprecation.

अभि-शस्ति, इस्, f. imprecation; curse, damnation;
effect of imprecation, misfortune, evil; one who curses
or injures; calumny, defamation, scandal; asking,
begging.
—अभिशस्ति-चातन, अस्, m., Ved. keeping
off imprecation.
—अभिशस्ति-पा, आस्, or अभिशस्ति-
पावन्, आ, m., Ved. defending from insults or impre-
cations.

अभिशक् अभि-शक्, Desid. Caus. -शिक्ष-
यति, -यितुम्, to teach.

अभिशङ्क् अभि-शङ्क्, cl. 1. A. -शङ्कते,
-कितुम्, to doubt, suspect, be suspicious.
अभि-शङ्का, f. doubt, alarm, suspicion.

अभि-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, doubtful, frightened,
alarmed.

अभिशप् अभि-शप्, cl. 1. P. A. -शपति, -ते,
-शप्तुम्, to execrate, curse.

अभि-शपन, अम्, n. or अभि-शाप, अस्, m. curse,
[]
imprecation; charge, accusation; false accusation,
calumny.
—अभिशाप-ज्वर, अस्, m. fever caused by
a curse.

अभि-शापन, अम्, n. pronouncing a curse or
malediction.

अभि-शप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cursed, accursed; falsely
accused, calumniated; reviled.

अभिशब्दित अभि-शब्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, de-
clared, announced.
अभि-शस्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, an injurer, an enemy.

अभिशान्त्व् अभि-शान्त्व्, cl. 10. P. -शान्त्व-
यति, -यितुम्, to pacify, appease, reconcile, comfort.
See अभि-सान्त्व्.

cl. 10. P. -सान्त्वयति, -यितुम्, to conciliate, pacify,
comfort.
अभि-शन्त्व, अम्, n. graciousness, complaisance.

अभि-सान्त्व or अभि-शान्त्व, अस्, m. consolation,
conciliation.

अभिशीत अभि-शीत or अभि-श्यात, अस्, आ, अम्
(rt. श्यै), cold, chilly.

अभि-सीन or अभि-श्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, coagulated,
congealed.

-तुम्, to join in coming near or approaching, to go
in quest of.

अभिसम्पच् अभि-सम्-पच्, Pass. -पच्यते,
to become ripe at a certain time (with acc.).

अभिसम्पत् अभि-सम्-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति,
-तितुम्, to fly to, hasten to, jump upon; to fly along.
अभि-सम्पात, अस्, m. concourse, war, battle.

अभिसम्पद् 1. अभि-सम्-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्-
यते, -पत्तुम्, to become anything, become similar
to, be changed to; to come to, arrive at; to obtain:
Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to make equal, change into.

2. अभि-सम्पद्, त्, f. becoming complete, complete
number.

अभि-सम्पत्ति, इस्, f. becoming or being effected
completely; transition.

अभि-सम्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, complete, completely
effected.

अभिसम्पराय अभि-सम्पराय, अस्, m. (rt. इ
with परा and सम्), futurity.

अभिसम्पूज् अभि-सम्-पूज्, cl. 10. P. -पूज-
यति, -यितुम्, to honour, revere greatly.

अभिसम्प्रपद् अभि-सम्-प्र-पद्, cl. 4. A.
-पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to come towards, share in.

अभिसम्प्राप् अभि-सम्-प्राप् (-प्र-आप्), cl. 5.
P. -आप्नोति, -आप्तुम्, to reach, come to, arrive at,
get, obtain.

अभिसम्प्रेक्ष् अभि-सम्-प्रेक्ष् (-प्र-ईक्ष्),
cl. 1. A. -प्रेक्षते, -षितुम्, to look at, perceive.

अभिसम्बन्ध् अभि-सम्-बन्ध्, Pass. -बध्-
यते, to be connected with, to relate or refer to.

अभि-सम्बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, connected with, re-
ferring to.

अभि-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. connection; contact,
conjunction, relation; sexual connection.

अभिसम्बाध अभि-सम्बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, very
confined or contracted.

अभिसम्भू अभि-सम्-भू, cl. 1. P., Ved. -भ-
वति, -वितुम्, to be near to, to enjoy.

अभिसम्मुख अभि-सम्मुख, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्,
fronting, facing; looking respectfully towards.

अभिसर अभि-सर, अभि-सर्ग, &c. See
अभि-सृ, अभि-सृज्.

अभि-सर, अस्, m. a companion, a follower; N.
of a people.
अभि-सर; add — an assailant.

अभि-सार, अस्, m. attack, assault; meeting, rendez-
vous; companion, follower; war, battle; a purificatory
rite; going to meet a lover, an assignation, appoint-
ment; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (ई), f., N. of a town.

अभिसर्पण अभि-सर्पण, अम्, n. (rt. सृप्),
coming near.

अभिसायम् अभि-सायम्, ind. about evening,
at sunset.

अभिसुसूष् अभि-सुसूष्, ऊस्, ऊस्, ऊस्, or अभि-
सोष्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, desirous of expressing
Soma juice. See अभि-षु.

अभिसूच् अभि-सूच्, cl. 10. P. -सूचयति, -यि-
तुम्, to point out, show.
अभि-सूचित, अस्, आ, अम्, pointed out.

अभिसूद् अभि-सूद्, cl. 10. P. -सूदयति,
-यितुम्, to kill outright, destroy utterly.

अभिसृ अभि-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्,
to approach, go towards, advance in order to meet, to
attack: Caus. P. -सारयति, -यितुम्, to visit, approach.

अभि-सरण, अम्, n. approaching, meeting, ren-
dezvous, going to meet.
अभि-सरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going to meet, attacking.
अभि-सर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, attacking, assailant.

अभि-सारिका, f. a. woman who goes to meet her
lover or keeps an assignation.

अभि-सारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, going to meet, visiting,
attacking; (इणी), f. a woman who keeps an assigna-
tion or goes to meet her lover; N. of a species of
the Triṣṭubh metre, in which two Pādas contain
twelve instead of eleven syllables, and which therefore
is said to approach another metre called Jagatī.
अभि-सार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being approached.
अभि-सृत्य, ind. having gone near.

अभिसृज् अभि-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्र-
ष्टुम्, to pour forth, to give.
अभि-सर्ग, अस्, m. creation.
अभि-सर्जन, अम्, n. gift, donation; killing (?).
अभि-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, given.

अभिसेवन अभि-सेवन, अम्, n. practising,
cultivating.

अभिस्कन्द अभि-स्कन्द, अस्, m., Ved. as-
sault; an assailant; (अम्), ind. by assailing.
अभिस्थिरम् अभि-स्थिरम्, ind. very firmly.

अभिस्नेह अभि-स्नेह, अस्, m. attachment,
affection, desire.

अभिस्फुरित अभि-स्फुरित, अस्, आ, अम्, ex-
panded to the full (as a blossom).

अभिस्मि अभि-स्मि, cl. 1. A., poet. P. -स्म-
यते, -ति, -स्मेतुम्, to smile upon.

अभिस्वयमातृण्णम् अभि-स्वयमातृण्णम्, ind.,
Ved. on the brick (used in sacrifices and called) स्व-
यम्-आतृण्ण (perforated in itself, i. e. full of holes).

अभिस्वृ अभि-स्वृ, cl. 1. P., Ved. -स्वरति,
-स्वर्तुम्, -रितुम्, to approve, praise, invoke.

अभि-स्वर्, अर्, f., Ved. invocation; calling into
(one's) presence; a hymn or song of praise.

अभि-स्वर्तृ, ता, m., Ved. invoking, praising, an
invoker.

अभिहन् अभि-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -तुम्, to
thump at, strike, kill; to beat off, drive off.
अभि-हति, इस्, f. striking; (in arithm.) multiplication.

अभि-हन्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being smitten, kill-
ed, &c.

अभिहव 1. अभि-हव, अस्, m. (rt. ह्वे), in-
vocation; (for 2. see under अभि-हु below.)
2. अभि-हव, अस्, m. oblation, sacrifice. See above.
अभि-हूति, इस्, f. invocation, worshipping.

अभिहस्य अभि-हस्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. हस्),
Ved. ridiculous, laughable.
अभि-हास, अस्, m. jest, joke, mirth.

अभि-हिति, इस्, f. telling, manifesting, title. See
अभि-धान.

अभिहु अभि-हु, cl. 3. P. -जुहोति, -होतुम्,
Ved. -होतवै, to make an oblation, sacrifice.

अभि-होम, अस्, m. making the oblation of clarified
butter.

अभिहृ अभि-हृ, cl. 1. P. -हरति, -हर्तुम्,
to snatch away, carry off; to bring: Caus. P. -हार-
यति, -यितुम्, to make a sudden attack.
अभि-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying off, removing.

अभि-हार, अस्, m. robbing, seizing anything in
the owner's presence; a brisk attack; effort; arming,
taking up arms; mingling together.

अभि-हरण, अम्, n. bringing near, conveying,
robbing.

अभि-हरणीय or अभि-हर्तव्य or अभि-हार्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought near.

अभि-हर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who snatches away,
seizes, takes by violence; a ravisher.

अभिह्रुत् अभि-ह्रुत्, त्, त्, त् (rt. ह्वृ), Ved.
bending, causing crookedness, acting injuriously; (त्),
f. fall, defeat, damage.

अभि-ह्रुति, इस्, f. causing to fall; defeat, damage,
offence; offensive, injurious.

अभि-ह्वर or अभि-ह्वार, अस्, आ, अम्, falling
off; crookedness, sin.

अभीत्वन्, वा, वरी, m. f., Ved. approaching, at-
tacking: also written अभीत्वर, अस्, ई, अम्.

अभीक्ष् अभीक्ष् (अभि-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -ईक्-
षते, -षितुम्, to look towards.

अभीक्ष्ण अभीक्ष्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (contraction
of अभि-क्षण), repeated, frequent; constant, per-
petual: (अम्), ind. repeatedly, again and again;
perpetually, constantly; very, exceedingly; quickly.
—अभीक्ष्ण-शस्, ind. repeatedly.

आभीक्ष्ण आभीक्ष्ण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभीक्ष्ण),
much, exceeding, eternal; (अम्), ind. exceedingly,
eternally.

अभीज्य अभीज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. यज्), to be
sacrificed to, one to whom sacrifice is offered: (अस्),
m. a god.

अभीत अ-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, not terrified,
fearless.
—अभीत-वत्, ind. as one not afraid, fear-
lessly.

अभीन्ध् अभीन्ध् (अभि-इन्ध्), cl. 7. A.
-इन्द्धे, -इन्धितुम्, to surround with flames, to in-
flame.
अभीद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, inflamed, shining.

अभीपतस् अभीपतस्, ind. (fr. rt. आप् with
अभि), Ved. according to the event, at the right time (?).

अभीप्सित अभीप्सित, अस्, आ, अम् (ईप्स्, Desid.
of rt. आप्; see अभ्य्-आप्), desired, wished.
अभीप्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, desired, acceptable, dear.

अभीप्सिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or अभीप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, de-
sirous of obtaining, wishing.

अभीम अ-भीम, अस्, आ, अम्, unterrific, causing
no fear; (अस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu.

अभीमोद अभी-मोद, अस्, m. (rt. मुद्), joy.
—अभीमोद-मुद् (only used in pl.), Ved. intense
joy and pleasure; or अभी-मोदमुद्, excessively
joyful (fr. irreg. intens. of rt. मुद्).

अभीर अभीर, अस्, m. a cowherd; N. of a
people; (ई), f. the language of this people; (अम्), n.,
N. of a metre, containing four Pādas with eleven
Mātrās in each Pāda.

आभीर आभीर, अस्, m., N. of a people; a
cowherd sprung from a Brāhman and female of the
[]
Ambaṣṭha or medical tribe; N. of a metre; (ई),
f. a cowherd's wife or woman of the Ābhīra tribe;
the language of the Ābhīra.
—आभीर-पल्लि, इस् or ई
or इका, f. a station of herdsmen, a village inhabited
by cowherds only, an abode of cowherds &c.

अभीरणी अभीरणी, f. (rt. ईर्?), a kind of
serpent.

अभीराजी अभीराजी, f. a kind of poisonous
insect.
अ-भीरुण, अस्, आ, अम्, unterrific, fearless, innocent.

अ-भीलु, उस्, उस्, उ (for अ-भीरु), or अभीलुक,
अस्, आ, अम्, fearless.

अभीलापलप् अभीलाप-लप् (only used in
pl.), Ved. discourse and talk; or अभी-लापलप्, talk-
ing excessively, whimpering (fr. irreg. intens. of rt.
लप्, cf. अभी-मोदमुद् last col.).

अभीवर्ग अभी-वर्ग, अस्, m. (rt. वृज्), circuit,
compass.

अभीशाप अभी-शाप, अस्, m. (rt. शप्), curse,
imprecation. See अभि-शपन.

अभीष् अभीष् (अभि-इष्), cl. 6. P. अभीच्-
छति, अभ्य्-एषितुम्, -ष्टुम्, to seek for, long for,
endeavour to gain.
अभीच्छत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, wishing, desiring.

अभीष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, wished, desired; acceptable,
dear, favourite, darling; optional; (आ), f. a mistress;
betel.
—अभीष्ट-ता, f. state of being desired.
—अभीष्ट-देवता, f. beloved goddess, favourite
deity.
—अभीष्ट-लाभ, अस्, m. or अभीष्ट-सिद्-
धि, इस्, f. the gaining a desired object.

अभीषया अ-भीषया, ind. (inst. case of
अभीषा), fearlessly.

आभिचरणिक आभिचरणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr.
अभि-चरण), maledictory, imprecatory, serving for
malediction or cursing.

आभिचारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-चार), magical,
relating to magic; (अम्), n. incantation, magic.

आभिधानिक, अस्, ई, अम्, contained in a dictionary,
lexicographical; (अस्), m. a lexicographer.

आभिधानीयक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-धान), re-
lating or belonging to a name or word; (अम्), n. the
property of a name.

आभिप्लविक आभिप्लविक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-
प्लव), relating to the religious ceremony called
Abhi-plava.

आभिमुख्य आभिमुख्य, अम्, n. (fr. अभि-
मुख), direction towards anything; wish or desire
directed towards anything; presence, being in front
of or face to face.

आभिहारिक आभिहारिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अभि-
हार), taken by force or fraud; (अम्), n. a room.
आभीक्ष्ण्य, अम्, n. continued repetition.

आभील आ-भील, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. भी with
आ), formidable, fearful; suffering pain; (अम्), n.
bodily pain; [cf. Hib. abhéil, ‘terrible, dreadful.’]

अभि-गृध्न, अस्, आ, अम्, eagerly desiring, greedy
for.
अभि-देवन, अम्, n. a gambling-table, dice-table.
अभि-पाल, अस्, m. a protector, watcher.
अभि-पालन, अम्, n. protection, watching.
अभि-प्रधर्षण, अम्, n. assault, ill-treatment.
अभि-प्रवेश, अस्, m. entering, entrance.
अभि-मारुतम्, ind. against the wind.

अभि-मुखय, Nom. P. -मुखयति, &c., to
face, encounter.
अभि-सञ्ज्ञित, अस्, आ, अम्, called, named.
